newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai SEC approves draft equity short sale rules.
newsitem.headline: Thai SEC approves draft equity short sale rules.

text.p: The Thai Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) on Thursday approved draft regulations legalising equity short sales, SEC officials said.
They said said the board of the market watchdog endorsed the short sale rules which, the authorities hoped, would boost buying demand on the Thai bourse which tumbled 35 percent in 1996.
It was not immediately known when the rules will go into effect but SEC officials had earlier expressed hopes that they could be implemented during the first quarter of 1997.

SEC Secretary General Pakorn Malakul na Ayutthya told reporters on Thursday the approved rules specify damage liabilities faced by brokerage firms if their clients default on obligations arising from short sale transactions. This, he said, was aimed at protectecting retail investors,
He said legal short sales would be permitted only for selected listed stocks with fair trading liquidity. He did not elaborate.
The SEC chief said the regulations would be effective after they are vetted by the Thai juridical council and endorsed by the cabinet. He did not say how long the process will take.
